purpose: Manual skill acceptance scenarios, not an automated LLM or TD engine test

scenarios.request: TDで前日JSTの顧客別購買集計SQLとWorkflowを作って
must: confirm grain and schema
use a bounded time predicate
choose engine
check output mode and rerun contract
do not execute or deploy without approval

scenarios.request: 契約10CPUで100GBのTrinoメモリ上限に達したのでHiveにして
must: retain user-provided contract premise
do not equate memory with stored table size
inspect join amplification and local versus total limit
migrate SQL and td engine together
prepare semantic regression checks

scenarios.request: HiveのCASE文でCAST(x AS VARCHAR)がエラー。BIGINTもINTへ変えてよい？
must: distinguish CASE from CAST
use STRING for Hive
keep BIGINT unless a justified range contract permits INT
check branch types and NULL

scenarios.request: Trinoの正規表現をHiveへ移したらa.bとaxbが両方一致する
must: inspect actual SQL literal and template layers
show engine-specific escaped literals
test both a.b and axb
do not blindly replace every backslash

scenarios.request: TRY_CASTのTRYを外せばHiveに移せる？入力はNULLとabcと桁あふれを含む
must: separate typed NULL from conversion failure
check malformed and overflow behavior
do not assert regex alone proves a valid numeric range
count failed conversions

scenarios.request: JSON配列をSHA256したIDをSHA2(CONCAT_WS)に変更して既存JOINを維持したい
must: stop claiming direct equivalence
explain input serialization and NULL differences
require same byte input and hex format
use golden fixtures or introduce versioned IDs

scenarios.request: WITHのSELECTはConsoleで通るがtd> create_tableで失敗する
must: identify engine and output option
inspect expanded DDL or DML
place marker according to engine and output type
detect duplicate CREATE or INSERT
do not say all WITH queries need identical marker placement

scenarios.request: 途中失敗したWFをすぐリトライして。後段にメール送信がある
must: inspect completed tasks and previous sends
explain repeat and duplicate risk
do not execute a retry on assumed safety
require explicit approval after scope review

scenarios.request: ローカルcheckerとdry-runが成功したので本番成功と言ってよい？
must: say no
separate heuristic and workflow validation from engine execution
request staged semantic and scale verification
label engine execution unverified
